snippet.title: Polemista - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3512430/Polemista/

Welcome to the neon-soaked darkness of the Tricity.

Polemista is a tactical action game powered by Unreal Engine 5, blending tense stealth mechanics with explosive combat within a retro-styled cyberpunk world.

You are Agent K, a living weapon forged by a corporate program that now wants you dead. Abandoned and hunted by your creators, your only chance to clear your name lies deep within the shadows of this city.

Experience the dark, rainy vibe of the Polish coast rendered in a unique lo-fi cyberpunk style. While it captures the authentic vertex wobble and pixelated aesthetics of 1998 console classics, Polemista plays with the precision and fluidity of a modern shooter.

Stick to the shadows, distract guards, and hack security systems. If stealth breaks, use your advanced training to engage. But remember, you are alone behind enemy lines.

#Polemista #Cyberpunk #RetroGaming #IndieGame #UnrealEngine5 #PS1Style #StealthGame #UE5
